name: Release deployment checklist
description: Review a release, confirm approval, and verify the result.

steps.title: Review changes
steps.instructions: Review the change summary, test results, and rollback plan. Confirm that the release is ready.

steps.title: Approve release
steps.prompt: Do you explicitly approve proceeding with this release?

steps.title: Verify release
steps.instructions: After the release is performed by your normal deployment process, inspect health indicators and record the result.
